notes: "I want to begin with why I started HUANDENG. At lab meetings, I wanted AI to help prepare slides while keeping my own judgment visible. I also kept running into another problem: changing two slides could leave me with another complete copy of the deck. Those experiences led me to put the human story, page identity and editable material into one project."

designIntent.purpose: Introduce why I started HUANDENG through concrete frustrations from preparing lab meetings.
keep: Keep source figures, labels, measured values and citations
Keep intentional background roles, product identity and meaningful density
Keep the first-person motivation and actual editor image.
designIntent.requestedChange: Use the founder’s account to explain one experience or the design choice it prompted.
